physicalEvidence.summary: Full 3D-CAVLA March 30, 2026 v2 §IV-D deploys learned policies on a real Franka arm using50 teleoperated demonstrations for each of10 tabletop tasks. The paper calls execution open-loop beyond RGB-D observations; CoT/ROI preparation occurs once before rollout. All authors areNYU-affiliated, but CRRL’s roster identifies Khorrami as PI; Karri’s separate hardware ownership/access is unverified. Physical20.
